findings.issue: single-image TEAM_NUMBER() == -1 and THIS_IMAGE() == 1 executable plans violated the out-of-scope decision
findings.resolution: every TEAM_NUMBER/THIS_IMAGE runtime observation is out of scope; only argument restrictions registered

findings.issue: TINY omitted the portable FRACTION relation
findings.resolution: FRACTION(TINY(x)) == 1.0/RADIX(x) alongside EXPONENT(TINY(x)) == MINEXPONENT(x), default and double

findings.issue: TOKENIZE had no zero-length STRING plan
findings.resolution: STRING = '' gives exactly one zero-length token, no separators, FIRST = [1], LAST = [0]

findings.issue: TRAILZ lacked the leftmost-bit and second-kind cases
findings.resolution: IBSET(0_k, BIT_SIZE(0_k)-1) gives BIT_SIZE-1, zero gives BIT_SIZE, a middle-bit case, for default and SELECTED_INT_KIND(18)
